title: FastAPI

desc: A modern Python framework for building typed HTTP APIs with automatic OpenAPI docs.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install FastAPI and start a development server.

snippets.code:
# Create a virtual environment and install FastAPI with the CLI extras
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install "fastapi[standard]"

# Start the development server with reload enabled
fastapi dev main.py

# Production-style start with several uvicorn workers
uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 4

sections.title: Application
sections.description: Create the application object and manage startup and shutdown.

snippets.code:
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from fastapi import FastAPI

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    app.state.connection_pool = {"size": 10}  # created once at startup
    yield
    app.state.connection_pool = None          # released at shutdown

app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)

sections.title: Pydantic Models
sections.description: Describe request and response bodies with Pydantic.

snippets.code:
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Address(BaseModel):
    street: str
    city: str
    postal_code: str = Field(pattern=r"^\d{5}$")

class Customer(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    email: str
    address: Address
    tags: list[str] = []

customer = Customer(
    id=7,
    name="Ana Lima",
    email="ana@example.com",
    address={
        "street": "Rua das Flores 12",
        "city": "Porto Alegre",
        "postal_code": "90010",
    },
    tags=["vip"],
)
print(customer.address.city)

sections.title: Async
sections.description: Use async handlers and keep the event loop free.

snippets.code:
import httpx
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/rates")
async def rates():
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=5.0) as client:
        response = await client.get("https://api.example.com/rates")
        response.raise_for_status()
        return response.json()

from collections.abc import Generator
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, Session, mapped_column, sessionmaker

class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass

class Book(Base):
    __tablename__ = "books"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str]

engine = create_engine(
    "sqlite:///library.db",
    connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
)
SessionLocal = sessionmaker(bind=engine, expire_on_commit=False)

def get_db() -> Generator[Session, None, None]:
    with SessionLocal() as session:
        yield session

app = FastAPI()

@app.get("/books")
def list_books(db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    books = db.scalars(select(Book)).all()
    return [{"id": book.id, "title": book.title} for book in books]

from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
from typing import Annotated
from fastapi import Depends
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker, create_async_engine

engine = create_async_engine("postgresql+asyncpg://app:secret@localhost/inventory")
AsyncSessionLocal = async_sessionmaker(engine, expire_on_commit=False)

async def get_session() -> AsyncIterator[AsyncSession]:
    async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session:
        yield session

@app.get("/books-async")
async def list_books_async(
    session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_session)],
):
    books = (await session.execute(select(Book))).scalars().all()
    return [{"id": book.id, "title": book.title} for book in books]

sections.title: Testing
sections.description: Exercise the app with an in-process test client.

snippets.code:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    response = client.get("/health")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json() == {"status": "ok"}

def test_create_item():
    response = client.post("/items", params={"name": "Ladder"})
    assert response.status_code == 201
    assert response.json()["name"] == "Ladder"
